name: USB-C Rechargeable Foldable Mini Fan with Display
shortDescription: Foldable handheld and desk fan with USB-C charging and digital display.
description: A white foldable mini fan with a digital battery display and USB-C charging, usable handheld or standing on a desk. Charges in about 3.5 hours and fits in a bag.
highlights: Folds 90° to stand on a desk
